project: Machine learning platform for heterogeneous accelerator clusters
summary:
- University: Hong Kong Polytechnic University
- Department: Department of Computing
- Project: Machine learning platform for heterogeneous accelerator clusters
- Duties: The appointees will assist the project leader in the research project – “Machine learning platform for heterogeneous accelerator clusters”. They will be required to (a) design and develop an efficient asynchronous checkpointing strategy during model training to enable rapid recovery in the event of failures; (b) design and develop an efficient parameter and optimiser compression algorithm for the checkpointing process during model training; and (c) perform any other duties as assigned by the project leader, the Head of Unit or their delegates.
- Requirements: Applicants should have an honours degree or an equivalent qualification.
- Appointment: (Ref. 260401013): each for eight months
- Conditions: A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Consideration of applications will commence on 8 April 2026 until the positions are filled.
- Contact: Applicants are invited to contact Dr Zhang Zhaorui at telephone number 2766 7869 or via email at zhaorui.zhang@polyu.edu.hk for further information.
- Closing date: 2026-04-08

summary:
- University: Hong Kong Polytechnic University
- Department: Department of Rehabilitation Sciences
- Project: Development of individual vocational health profiles and vocational health protocols to facilitate transition of students with intellectual disabilities from school to work
- Duties: The appointee will assist the project leader in the research project - “Development of individual vocational health profiles and vocational health protocols to facilitate transition of students with intellectual disabilities from school to work”. He/She will be required to (a) assist in project implementation, including preparation of project materials, literature review, data collection, data entry and analysis as well as report writing; and (b) perform any other duties as assigned by the project leader or his/her delegates.
- Requirements: Applicants should (a) have an honours degree in Rehabilitation, Psychology, Social Sciences or other health-related disciplines or an equivalent qualification; (b) have working experience in data collection, qualitative and quantitative data analysis as well as other research supporting work; (c) have a good command of both written and spoken English and Chinese, with fluency in Cantonese; (d) have good organisational, communication and interpersonal skills; (e) have a strong sense of responsibility; and (f) be self-motivated and able to work independently.
- Appointment: (Ref. 260401010): six to twelve months initially, with possibility of further appointment
- Conditions: A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Consideration of applications will commence on 8 April 2026 until the position is filled.
- Contact: Applicants are invited to contact Miss Sammy Wong at telephone number 2766 6770 or via email at sammywsl.wong@polyu.edu.hk for further information.
- Closing date: 2026-04-08
